name: Viral Reel Rush
hook: Stack automated engagement hooks before the algorithm flags your account as pure slop
tagline: An influencer pushes an AI video machine to pump out auto-generated short reels with neon captions and loud stock footage. As the multiplier rises, the view counter spins out of control and subscriber notifications flood the screen like a tsunami. Cash out to enjoy genuine viral clout, or crash when the algorithm slaps a permanent shadowban across all platforms.
